legend: Ivan had string s consisting of small English letters. However, his friend Julia decided to make fun of him and hid the string s. Ivan preferred making a new string to finding the old one.

Ivan knows some information about the string s. Namely, he remembers, that string ti occurs in string s at least ki times or more, he also remembers exactly ki positions where the string ti occurs in string s: these positions are xi, 1, xi, 2, ..., xi, ki. He remembers n such strings ti.
You are to reconstruct lexicographically minimal string s such that it fits all the information Ivan remembers. Strings ti and string s consist of small English letters only.
input: The first line contains single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 105) — the number of strings Ivan remembers.

The next n lines contain information about the strings. The i-th of these lines contains non-empty string ti, then positive integer ki, which equal to the number of times the string ti occurs in string s, and then ki distinct positive integers xi, 1, xi, 2, ..., xi, ki in increasing order — positions, in which occurrences of the string ti in the string s start. It is guaranteed that the sum of lengths of strings ti doesn't exceed 106, 1 ≤ xi, j ≤ 106, 1 ≤ ki ≤ 106, and the sum of all ki doesn't exceed 106. The strings ti can coincide.
It is guaranteed that the input data is not self-contradictory, and thus at least one answer always exists.
output: Print lexicographically minimal string that fits all the information Ivan remembers.

legend.ai: Ivan 有一个由小写英文字母组成的字符串 s。然而，他的朋友 Julia 决定捉弄他，把字符串 s 藏了起来。Ivan 宁愿构造一个新字符串，也不愿寻找旧字符串。
Ivan 知道关于字符串 s 的一些信息。具体来说，他记得字符串 ti 在字符串 s 中至少出现了 ki 次，并且他还准确记得字符串 ti 在字符串 s 中出现的 ki 个位置：这些位置为 xi, 1、xi, 2、...、xi, ki。他记得这样的一共 n 个字符串 ti。
请你构造出满足 Ivan 所记得的全部信息的字典序最小字符串 s。字符串 ti 和字符串 s 均只由小写英文字母组成。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 105），表示 Ivan 记得的字符串数量。

接下来的 n 行包含关于这些字符串的信息。其中第 i 行包含一个非空字符串 ti，接着是一个正整数 ki，表示字符串 ti 在字符串 s 中出现的次数，然后是 ki 个互不相同的正整数 xi, 1、xi, 2、...、xi, ki，且这些整数按递增顺序给出，表示字符串 ti 在字符串 s 中每次出现的起始位置。保证所有字符串 ti 的长度之和不超过 106，1 ≤ xi, j ≤ 106，1 ≤ ki ≤ 106，并且所有 ki 之和不超过 106。字符串 ti 之间可能相同。
保证输入数据不存在矛盾，因此至少总是存在一个答案。

output.ai: 输出满足 Ivan 所记得的全部信息的字典序最小字符串。
